'''Tomer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] controller in the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In circa [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the rogue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dal Konur]] traveled to the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] and obtained a [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray''-31-class patrol and attack craft]], which he began preparing for a mission into [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. While off-duty, Tomer was [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricked]] by Konur into helping prepare the craft for takeoff, and so that the hangar controller would identify himself as Konur if anyone approached him. Konur suspected that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the headmaster of the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], would send [[Agent/Legends|agents]] to capture him, and he hoped that Tomer's deception would momentarily distract anyone that Skywalker sent.
